findings.description: Target is v.substr(slashpos)+norm.substr(l->path.size())+query. An exact location match empties the remainder, so GET /api?cmd=whoami emits GET /exec?cmd=whoami HTTP/1.1, three tokens; a strict parser runs whoami. Bare GET /api runs id. No encoding client-side. Requires a URI naming the route with no trailing space and a strict 3-token reader.
findings.title: Exact-match URI without a trailing space keeps a 3-token line, so an attacker query alone executes a chosen command on a strict parser

findings.description: A quoted trailing space makes bare GET /api emit GET /exec  HTTP/1.1, four tokens; a whitespace-splitting upstream runs the default command. Requires the quoted space and that upstream shape.
findings.title: A quoted space in the proxy_pass URI is the separator, so a bare GET /api executes the upstream default command with no encoding

limitations: Different upstream reader needed per finding, stated
methods: Strict peer, verbatim line + token count, exact 3-token exec fire
